exact_strategy: Keep ORIGINAL_NEWS27A11 runner as the raw producer.
After original runner returns and raw after_count is measured, calculate raw_delta = after_count - before_count.
If raw_delta <= 0, do not run downstream.
Select up to 100 raw rows whose news_uid is not already in tracker and not already in news_token_match_events.
Run existing tools/news_token_matcher_v1.py logic against tracked token dictionary rows.
Update tracker atomically only after successful downstream batch.
Return original runner rc unless downstream hard failure occurs after raw was written; downstream failure must be logged and surfaced.
future_apply_acceptance_gates: Tracker file is created only in runtime/state.
A second run without new raw does not increase match/signal/score counts.
Existing 47 match/signal/score rows are not duplicated.
raw_without_match decreases or remains stable depending on match eligibility.
future_post_audit_required: One manual controlled run only if user approves.
Git clean and push seal after audit.
plan.goal: Attach a minimal downstream hook to the existing NEWS runner after the original runner completes, without introducing a new orchestrator.
